product: UltraFLEXplus automated test equipment screens AI/compute, HBM/DRAM/NAND memory and advanced-packaged devices from wafer to system rack (Business Wire 2026-09-01). Photon 100 and Iris 100 test silicon-photonics/CPO and microLED optical interconnects (Business Wire 2026-09-21). Robotics (UR cobots, MiR AMRs) was $100M in Q2-26 (Business Wire 2026-07-28).
demand: Volume-led: Q2-26 revenue $1,329M, up 104% YoY on year-on-year market expansion in all three groups (Business Wire 2026-07-28). Gross margin held about 59.8% (Q2-26 gross profit $794.6M vs revenue $1,329M), with mix aided by record Memory revenue; Q3 guide $1,200-1,300M implies a sequential step down.
pricing_power: Gross margin near 59.8% (Business Wire 2026-07-28). A few hyperscaler and memory customers concentrating revenue, AI capex digestion, tariffs or China export controls could cut high-margin AI volume; Teradyne own Q3 guide steps revenue to $1,200-1,300M from $1,329M, showing near-term sequential pressure (Business Wire 2026-07-28).
competition: Chinese ATE vendors (Accotest/Chranto, Huafeng Test and Control, Jingce) sell low-cost testers, but none were found to match Teradyne on leading-edge AI, HBM or CPO test as of 2026-09-27; no 2026 evidence they displace Teradyne at the AI frontier. Distance: still generations behind on high-pin-count, high-speed instruments (not found).
market_strategy: CEO Greg Smith, 2026-07-28: rapid increase in wafer fab equipment investment sets the stage for continued growth in 2027 and beyond (Business Wire). Guidance, 2026-07-28: Q3-26 revenue $1,200-1,300M, GAAP EPS $1.79-2.09, non-GAAP EPS $1.85-2.15 (Business Wire).
bull: Q2-26 revenue $1,329M, +104% YoY, beat high end; record Memory on DRAM/NAND; Q3 guide $1,200-1,300M; six of seven 90d analyst actions were raises; new UltraFLEXplus AI and Iris 100 microLED launches.
bear: Gross margin slipped to 59.8% from 60.9%; Q3 guide steps revenue down sequentially; Baird cut to Hold 2026-08-21; no news in 30d; 21d momentum 9.8% but 63d -8.8%; target levels are perverse per §17.
falsifier: Q3-26 earnings 2026-10-27: revenue below $1,200M or Semiconductor Test revenue down sequentially would show the AI/memory order cycle has rolled over.

web_bottleneck: Test intensity and throughput. CEO says advanced nodes, chiplets, HBM and CPO raise testing per chip (x.com/PhotonCap 2026-09-09); known-good-die screening gates high-value 2.5D/3D packages (Business Wire 2026-06-08); Teradyne manager Damian Megna says cooling is now a shared bottleneck (x.com/Teradyneinc 2026-09-25); optical alignment also named one (x.com/PhotonCap 2026-09-10).
web_who_benefits_next: Second-order beneficiaries: FormFactor ($FORM) probing and Aehr Test Systems ($AEHR) burn-in/wafer-level reliability, plus inspection, metrology and advanced-packaging suppliers (x.com/PhotonCap 2026-09-10); partner Tokyo Electron gains known-good-die prober pull-through (Business Wire 2026-06-08); probe-card, socket and handler vendors and OSATs gain as test intensity rises.
web_who_loses: Advantest, the main automated-test rival, loses share if Teradyne wins AI, HBM/DRAM and CPO test sockets (context). Bench-top optical-instrument vendors lose to production microLED test (Business Wire 2026-09-21). Cobot and AMR robotics rivals lose as Teradyne UR and MiR fleets ship into logistics and data-center operations (Business Wire 2026-09-01).
web_margin_collapse_risk: Gross margin near 59.8% (Business Wire 2026-07-28). A few hyperscaler and memory customers concentrating revenue, AI capex digestion, tariffs or China export controls could cut high-margin AI volume; Teradyne own Q3 guide steps revenue to $1,200-1,300M from $1,329M, showing near-term sequential pressure (Business Wire 2026-07-28).
web_low_cost_substitute: Chinese ATE vendors (Accotest/Chranto, Huafeng Test and Control, Jingce) sell low-cost testers, but none were found to match Teradyne on leading-edge AI, HBM or CPO test as of 2026-09-27; no 2026 evidence they displace Teradyne at the AI frontier. Distance: still generations behind on high-pin-count, high-speed instruments (not found).
web_ceo_promised: CEO Greg Smith, 2026-07-28: rapid increase in wafer fab equipment investment sets the stage for continued growth in 2027 and beyond (Business Wire). Guidance, 2026-07-28: Q3-26 revenue $1,200-1,300M, GAAP EPS $1.79-2.09, non-GAAP EPS $1.85-2.15 (Business Wire).
web_did_they_deliver: Yes. Q2-26 revenue $1,329M beat the Q2 guidance high end and was a second straight record (Business Wire 2026-07-28). Q1-26 was guided at $1,150-1,250M and delivered $1.28B (x.com/marketsday 2026-04-29). Q2-25 revenue base was $652M, so the guided +104% YoY was delivered.
web_what_would_falsify: Q3-26 earnings, due 2026-10-27 after close: revenue below $1,200M or Semiconductor Test revenue down sequentially would show the AI/memory order cycle has rolled over (engine pre-registered falsifier). A sequential decline in Memory test revenue on NAND/DRAM would likewise falsify the thesis.
